Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns of the catalysts are shown in Fig. 2. Metallic Pt with a face centered cubic (fcc) structure (ICSD 41525) was observed in the Pt/SiO2_O2, Pt/SiO2_N2, Pt/SiO2_H2 and Pt–Sn/SiO2_1073 K O2. In the XRD patterns of the Pt–Sn catalysts treated under a reductive atmosphere (Fig. 2(C)), a clear peak was present at 2θ = 39° for Pt3Sn phase (111) (ICSD 105796) and two peaks appeared at 2θ = 42° and 44° for a PtSn phase (ICSD 42593), indicating the Pt–Sn alloying on SiO2.
